mapper.select: SELECT p.idx as postIdx, p.category_idx as categoryIdx, c1.code_name as categoryName, p.range_idx as rangeIdx, c2.code_name as rangeName, p.title, p.content, p.view_count as viewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LIKE WHERE post_idx = p.idx AND comment_idx IS NULL) as likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_UNLIKE WHERE post_idx = p.idx AND comment_idx IS NULL) as unlikeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE post_idx = p.idx) as commentCount, p.created_at as createdAt, p.updated_at as updatedAt FROM TB_POST p LEFT JOIN TB_CODE c1 ON p.category_idx = c1.idx LEFT JOIN TB_CODE c2 ON p.range_idx = c2.idx WHERE p.member_idx = #{memberIdx} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT c.idx as commentIdx, c.post_idx as postIdx, p.title as postTitle, c.parent_comment_idx as parentCommentIdx, c.content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LIKE WHERE comment_idx = c.idx) as likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_UNLIKE WHERE comment_idx = c.idx) as unlikeCount, c.created_at as createdAt, c.updated_at as updatedAt FROM TB_COMMENT c LEFT JOIN TB_POST p ON c.post_idx = p.idx WHERE c.member_idx = #{memberIdx} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT l.idx as reactIdx, 'like' as reactType, l.post_idx as postIdx, p.title as postTitle, p.created_at as postCreatedAt, l.comment_idx as commentIdx, c.content as commentContent, c.created_at as commentCreatedAt, l.created_at as reactCreatedAt FROM TB_LIKE l LEFT JOIN TB_POST p ON l.post_idx = p.idx LEFT JOIN TB_COMMENT c ON l.comment_idx = c.idx WHERE l.member_idx = #{memberIdx} ORDER BY l.created_at DESC

SELECT u.idx as reactIdx, 'unlike' as reactType, u.post_idx as postIdx, p.title as postTitle, p.created_at as postCreatedAt, u.comment_idx as commentIdx, c.content as commentContent, c.created_at as commentCreatedAt, u.created_at as reactCreatedAt FROM TB_UNLIKE u LEFT JOIN TB_POST p ON u.post_idx = p.idx LEFT JOIN TB_COMMENT c ON u.comment_idx = c.idx WHERE u.member_idx = #{memberIdx} ORDER BY u.created_at DESC
